text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:

I didn't quote the contract itself. Finance terms are limited to the deal desk, the CFO and the account owner, and the Saltmarsh renewal order form (signed June 18, 2026) is the source to check against. Confirm the figure with June Osei-Lark before it goes into the brief.
